# Several apps

Show another Protobase app's records and accept its users.

- [Remote resources](../reference/remote-resources.md): An app shows another Protobase app's records with its own lists, record pages and sidebar.
- [Sign-in across apps](../reference/auth.md#users-of-another-app): An app accepts the signed-in users of another Protobase app and maps their roles.
